source_selection: Sort all official split records by SHA256 of UTF8 canonical JSON (sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators comma/colon); tie by original row index. Take first min(100,N). No outcome-dependent substitutions.
source_policy: Resolve and preserve public main and converted-parquet revisions and full raw split before sampling. Three transport attempts for retryable public-source HTTP failures, no credentials or model requests. Acquisition failures remain in the disposition record.

oracle_semantics.arc-challenge: Look up answerKey in choices.label; retain the aligned choices.text and gold position. Numeric labels are symbols in this lookup.
oracle_semantics.openbookqa: Look up answerKey in choices.label; retain aligned choices.text and gold position.
oracle_semantics.mmlu: answer is a zero-based index into choices.
oracle_semantics.mmlu-pro: answer_index is a zero-based index into options; independently require the answer letter to match when present.

checks: Frozen checker, independent field/choice/label checks, native question mutation probes, native scoring of canonical-letter and official-text oracles, every constant-letter control. The generator uses an inert local backend.
unknowns: Retain every selected source row. Any schema or scoring failure is recorded explicitly; do not remove rows or change the frozen checker.
calibration_restriction: The checker file is byte-pinned and will not be changed based on these four panels; source adapters explicitly implement the prospective source semantics above.
interpretation: Prospective diagnostic extension inside one framework. It does not estimate deployment prevalence or prove affected published model scores.
prespecified_repair: Bind original question fields directly into the declared source template, preserve the official complete option order and canonical answer label, and use a parser sized to the source choice count. This is a source-bound intervention, not a change to the frozen checker.
